text.description_html:
Falcon SC71AL, ADA Compliant Full Cover Heavy Duty Door Closer

When you need a dependable closer for a standard-duty application, the Falcon SC61A Series gets the job done. Designed for use with an aluminum storefront, the SC61A Series offers ANSI grade 1 durability backed by a ten-year warranty. Most common hole pattern in the industry for versatile use and easy retrofit.

Specifications and Features for the Falcon SC61A Commercial Door Closer:

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable Back Check
  • Single piece cast aluminum body
  • Non-Handed
  • Grade 1 (Highest Grade)
  • UL 10C Approved
  • Spring Size: 1-5
  • ADA Compliant
  • 10 Year Warranty

The Falcon SC61A is ADA Compliant offering adjustable spring power sizes 1 - 5.
